It is a Shikinaisha listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}} of {{ill|Settsu Province|ca|Província de Settsu|cs|Provincie Seccu|de|Provinz Settsu|eo|Provinco Seccu|es|Provincia de Settsu|fa|ولایت ستسو|fr|Province de Settsu|gl|Provincia de Settsu|hak|Settsu-koet|id|Provinsi Settsu|it|Settsu (provincia)|ja|摂津国|ko|셋쓰국|lt|Seccu žemė|nl|Settsu (provincie)|pt|Província de Settsu|ru|Сэтцу (провинция)|simple|Settsu Province|sk|Seccu (provincia)|sr|Провинција Сецу|tr|Settsu (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Сеццу|zh|攝津國|zh_min_nan|Settu-kok|zh_yue|攝津國|qid=Q864163}}, {{ill|Shimashimo district|ja|島下郡|zh|岛下郡|qid=Q10976940}}. It is also called Sansho Myōjin. {{nihongo|'''Io Shrine'''|井於神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Settsu Province]].

==History==
It is said that the shrine was originally located in Unobe and was transferred to its present site during the Kyōtoku era ({{ill|1452|Q6460|qid=Q6460}}–{{ill|1454|Q6476|qid=Q6476}}). In the *Shoku Nihongi*, an entry appears for Inohe no Muraji in the 4th month of the 2nd year of Tenpyō-jingo ({{ill|765|Q31216|qid=Q31216}}), and it is thought that he enshrined his {{ill|Ujigami|Q767655|qid=Q767655}}.
* During the Eishō era ({{ill|1504|Q6148|qid=Q6148}}–{{ill|1520|Q6284|qid=Q6284}}), Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto was invited by Miyake Dewanokami.
* In the 5th year of Meiji ({{ill|1872|Q7753|qid=Q7753}}), it was ranked as a {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}.
* In Meiji 40 ({{ill|1907|Q2048|qid=Q2048}}), it was designated a shrine receiving offerings of sacred food and ritual paper.
* In September of Meiji 43 ({{ill|1910|Q2075|qid=Q2075}}), Hachiman Shrine in front of Unobe Hall, Kōtaijingū to the northeast, Tsuruno Nishikawa Kōtaijingū, and the minor shrine Suijinsha were jointly enshrined.

==Enshrined deities==
Currently, the following three deities are enshrined:
* {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|Q272993|qid=Q272993|lt=Takeshi-hayasu-susanoo-no-Mikoto}}
* {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto|qid=Q2564508}}
* {{ill|Sugawara no Michizane|ar|سوغاوارا نو ميتشيزانه|br|Sugawara no Michizane|ckb|سوگاوارا نۆ میچیزانێ|de|Sugawara no Michizane|es|Sugawara no Michizane|fa|سوگاوارا نو میچی‌زانه|fi|Sugawara no Michizane|fr|Sugawara no Michizane|id|Sugawara no Michizane|it|Sugawara no Michizane|ja|菅原道真|kk|Сугавара но Митидзане|ko|스가와라노 미치자네|la|Sugawara no Michizane|ms|Sugawara no Michizane|nl|Sugawara no Michizane|nn|Sugawara no Michizane|pl|Michizane Sugawara|pt|Sugawara no Michizane|ru|Сугавара-но Митидзанэ|sh|Sugawara no Michizane|sv|Sugawara no Michizane|th|สึกาวาระ โนะ มิจิซาเนะ|tr|Sugawara no Michizane|uk|Суґавара но Мітідзане|zh|菅原道真|zh_classical|菅原道真|zh_min_nan|Sugawara no Mitizane|qid=Q382005}}

==Subsidiary shrines==
* Hachiman Shrine: Suga Yahiro-no-Mikoto, Hachiman Ōkami, Amaterasu Ōmikami, Toyouke Ōkami
* Itsukushima Shrine: Ichikishimahime-no-Mikoto
* Suijin Shrine: Hanimisuhiko Ōkami, Mitsuhanome Ōkami
* Kōtaijingū: Amaterasu Ōmikami, Toyouke Ōkami
* Ōkuni Shrine: Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto, Ōkuninushi-no-Mikoto
